experiment: P08 live JPEG regional readback ABBA

platforms.link: authenticated JWM TCP over an SSH loopback forward between the physical machines; Ubuntu side Wi-Fi

method.capture: explicit X11 Composite overlay, native size, CPU scaling policy, independent cursor, --max-width 0
method.view: native X11 1920x1080 XRGB viewer, JPEG fixed quality 85
method.source_painter: Xlib, claims compositor selection and paints private Xvfb Composite overlay

full_repaint.telemetry: one complete reporting window after discarding the possibly mixed first window

method.sampling: Discard complete windows through at least 30 seconds, retain complete sparse windows through at least 60 seconds at both ends.
method.treatment: B sets only JWM_REMOTE_X11_REGIONS=1 on host. A leaves the variable unset. Same per-endpoint binary.
method.source_samples: Painter verifies initial four exact X11 sample values before host listens.
method.viewer_samples: Require both changing color states and both immutable markers at eight coordinates on the actual viewer X11 drawable in each of two distinct phases.
method.telemetry_quantiles: Worst recent-observation window p95. It is not a trial percentile.
scope_limits: Synthetic sparse damage on private Xvfb displays
No physical display timing or production GPU-driver claims
Full readback count inferred from instrumented observations and verified frame dimensions
Regional pixel count records planned reads, including fallback
Wi-Fi throughput, RTT, packet loss and jitter not independently measured
Mailbox saturation was not deliberately injected

failed_attempts.observed_failure: viewer protocol I/O returned EAGAIN (os error 11)
failed_attempts.result: excluded incomplete attempt; rerun in a fresh isolated session with identical settings
